status: Geometry review prototype; not released for manufacture.
assembly: Bench-fit the bearings and spacers before installing the motors.
Install the hip hub, three metal tie sleeves and knee stator plate; verify actuator thread engagement and clamp preload separately.
Install the pushrod bushings, shoulder screws and captured nuts with the shells open.
Seat each shin bearing in its complete circular bore. Close the shin halves around the spacer and metal clamp sleeves.
Fit the shin between the thigh bearing stops, insert the knee axle sleeve and through-bolt, then close the thigh.
For bearing service, remove the knee axle and open the two structural halves. Use the rear extraction holes to press on the outer race.
limits: Printed strength, fatigue, motor heat, clamp preload, actual press fits and accumulated tolerances remain unqualified.
Metal parts need wall/pocket optimization and a supplier tool-access review before CNC ordering.
The nominal foot and motor envelopes are retained; their final retention and wiring details require hardware selection.
reuse_basis: Limb geometry and assembly placements are identical to the audited source.
lidar_neck_status: Integral seat and hood geometry reviewed; inherited hood/cradle release interference and selected sensor mounting prevent fabrication release.
